baseline_models.focus_anchor: ذلكم الله ربكم خالق كل شيء لا إله إلا هو
baseline_models.mechanism: The deictic identification joins the named God, the addressees' Lord, and the originator of the entire thing-domain; exclusive worship follows from the convergence of sovereignty, care, and creation in one referent.

activation_trace.role: The worship and worshipped image makes the doubled divine term frame exclusive devotion rather than a merely numerical classification.
Lordship as ownership and obeyed sovereignty supplies the relational claim contained in 'your Lord.'
Repair, nurture, and completion keep lordship from collapsing into bare possession.
Actual origination grounds the claim that the same referent is the source of the total domain.

changed_reading.before: A sequence of divine titles followed by a monotheistic formula.
changed_reading.after: The one who owns, tends, and originates the addressees and their whole world is thereby the sole proper object of worship.

baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is first heard as measured determination and realized form, while 'every thing' gathers all individually knowable items; the totality is structured and distributive rather than an undifferentiated mass.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation an ordered determination before realized production.
Completed and balanced form supplies the visible realization of that determination.
Enclosure and completion gather all parts without erasing their membership in the whole.
A thing as something knowable and reportable makes the universal claim range over each identifiable item.

changed_reading.after: Every identifiable thing lies within a prior measure and a realized form, so the whole is comprehensive without being vague.

baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative opens place, direction, manner, and condition, while the passive verb depicts an object being reversed from its proper face; the verse asks for the route and agency of a directional failure after orientation has already been supplied.

activation_trace.role: The interrogative branch asks from where, toward where, and in what manner the displacement occurs.
Reversing a thing from its face supplies the central spatial mechanism of being redirected from the established orientation.
A lie displaced from truth opens a concurrent discursive route by which the directional reversal can occur.

changed_reading.after: A diagnostic question asks by what route, under what agency, and through what truth-reversing process the addressees are being redirected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exclusive deity claim becomes a working address-response and obedience relation: God alone is called, the Lord answers, devotion is cleared of partners, and worship is directed to Him rather than to rival addressees.

activation_trace.role: Calling as vocal address and inclination turns divine uniqueness into the selection of one addressee.
Divine oneness without a partner closes the address against shared recipients.
The return of speech as an answer completes the call-response circuit promised by 'your Lord.'
Exclusive separation from partnership makes devotion an unmixed relation.
Obedience and submission make the exclusive claim govern allegiance as well as verbal invocation.
Humble worship identifies the concrete practice prohibited toward rival objects.

structural_cues: 40:60 places 'your Lord' immediately before the call-answer pair and contrasts refusal with arrogance from worship.
40:65-66 repeat no deity but He, exclusive invocation, and refusal of other worship as one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated exclusive address, promised answer, purified obedience, and prohibited rival worship; I infer that lordship establishes a unique relational channel, while the live alternative is that these are parallel commands rather than a causal unpacking of 40:62.

changed_reading.before: No deity except Him states a proposition about divine number.
changed_reading.after: No deity except Him allocates invocation, expected answer, obedience, and worship to the one Lord who created the caller.

context_deltas.mechanism: The passive turning is socially mediated by opposed calls: speech inclines a hearer toward either rescue or fire, and the call toward associating an unknown partner supplies a human vector that can redirect worship.

activation_trace.role: Being turned from a proper face anchors the social calls as competing directional forces.
The two calls literally use speech to incline toward opposed destinations, making verbal invitation a directional mechanism.
Rescue by separation supplies the destination of the believer's counter-vector.
Participation and partnership identify the rival call's mechanism as dividing the exclusive relation.

structural_cues: 40:41 balances 'I call you' against 'you call me' and gives each call a different destination.
40:42 specifies that the rival call seeks disbelief and association while the counter-call names the Mighty, Forgiving one.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed verbal calls and destinations; I infer that speech-induced inclination is one human mechanism behind the passive redirection, while the alternative is that the calls only exemplify opposed choices and do not explain the passive agency.

changed_reading.before: The addressee inexplicably turns away as an isolated chooser.
changed_reading.after: The addressee stands in a field of rival voices whose calls bend allegiance toward rescue or toward association and fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The Creator's totality is unpacked as functional configuration: temporal rhythm enables rest and sight, earth and sky become stable habitation, bodies receive formed appearance, and nourishment is assigned. Creation is an affordance-bearing life-world whose fittingness calls for recognition.

activation_trace.role: Making something into a state turns night and day from inventory items into configured conditions.
Cessation of movement gives night the concrete function of repose.
Recognizing a benefit and praising its giver supplies the expected response to configured creation.
Stability and settlement make the earth a supporting base rather than bare material.
Building by joining parts supplies the sky's complementary structural role.
Embodied image and formed configuration bring the creative mechanism into the addressees' own bodies.
Nourishing sustenance shows the configured world maintaining the life it houses.

structural_cues: 40:61 immediately precedes the focus with night, rest, visible day, favor, and failed gratitude.
40:64 immediately repeats 'that is Allah, your Lord' after earth, sky, form, beauty, and provision.
40:79-81 extend configuration into transport, food, benefit, carried movement, and visible signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a series of made states and their human functions; I infer that coordinated affordance is evidence linking Creator to Lord and failed gratitude to turning, while the alternative is that these gifts illustrate creation without defining its mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Creator of every thing denotes universal production.
changed_reading.after: Creator of every thing denotes a coordinated habitat whose rhythms, structures, bodies, and provisions are fitted for life and therefore point back to its Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet's non-dominant growth mapping for 'your Lord' becomes live beside the ordered human sequence: creation proceeds through dependent attachment, emergence, maturity, age, and a fixed term. Lordship can therefore be carried as phase-by-phase raising, not only static mastery.

activation_trace.role: Nurture and completion in the dominant mapping provide the secure bridge from lordship to development.
The split root's nourishment and growth image sharpens lordship into increase and maturation across phases.
Measured creation supplies an ordered design for the life-course rather than an accidental sequence.
The small water-drop stage supplies a materially minimal beginning for growth.
A pregnancy fixed in the womb supplies dependent attachment as a developmental transition.
Repeated arrival at a limit makes maturity and the final term successive governed goals.
A fixed temporal limit closes the same measured trajectory that began in material dependence.

structural_cues: 40:67 orders dust, drop, attachment, child, strength, old age, death, and an appointed term with repeated transition markers.
40:64 first places bodily forming and provision under the repeated title 'your Lord.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a split ر ب و growth branch and a measured chronological sequence; I infer that lordship names sustained maturation through those transitions, while the live alternative is that the non-dominant mapping is form-distant and the dominant ر ب ب nurture branch alone carries the relation.

changed_reading.before: Your Lord is a static title for owner or master.
changed_reading.after: Your Lord is also heard as the one who raises the addressee through measured dependencies, thresholds, maturity, and an appointed completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same universal thing-domain is successively enclosed by mercy and knowledge, denied any hiding place, and subjected to true judgment; rival objects cannot decide even one thing. Creative totality thus carries epistemic and jurisdictional reach.

activation_trace.role: Expansion opposed to narrowness lets mercy and knowledge cover the entire thing-domain.
The repeated encompassing totality ties the prayer's scope directly to the focus phrase.
Each knowable and reportable item becomes an object of mercy and knowledge as well as creation.
Concealment is explicitly negated, closing any hidden remainder outside divine knowledge.
Decisive judgment contrasts God's true decision with the invoked rivals' inability to decide.
The rivals' failure regarding even a single thing makes divine exclusivity jurisdictional within the same universal domain.

structural_cues: 40:7 repeats 'every thing' as the object of encompassing mercy and knowledge.
40:16 says no thing is hidden before the declaration of sole kingship.
40:20 contrasts God's true judgment with invoked rivals who judge nothing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated universal collocation across creation, mercy, knowledge, visibility, and judgment; I infer a coextensive field under one Lord, while the alternative is that these attributes share vocabulary without implying one integrated mechanism.

changed_reading.after: No created thing exits the one field of mercy, knowledge, disclosure, and true judgment, while rival deities possess no jurisdiction over even one item.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus passive becomes a repeatable discursive process: signs are knowingly denied, tightly twisted into dispute, speech is redirected from its face, and the book is branded false. Argumentative recasting does not merely accompany deflection; it can continually reproduce it.

activation_trace.role: The exact repeated passive reversal turns the focus question into a recognizable pattern rather than a one-time lapse.
Denial despite knowledge identifies the reversal as resistance to recognized signs, not simple absence of information.
Twisted contention supplies the argumentative operation immediately before the repeated directional question.
Turning something back from its face closely restates the focus's spatial reversal.
Speech redirected through embellishment or addition supplies an exploratory mechanism for argumentative recasting.
Attributing the book and message to falsehood states the discursive product of the preceding twist.

structural_cues: 40:63 immediately repeats the focus verb and identifies its subjects as people who deny God's signs.
40:69 repeats the same interrogative shape with disputation before a near-synonymous passive turning verb.
40:70 continues the syntax by identifying those subjects as people who declared the book and messengers false.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact rhetorical repetition and the denial-dispute-declaration sequence; I infer an arrow from argumentative twisting to sustained redirection, while the live alternative is that the passive points instead to social pressure or consequential divine misguidance.

changed_reading.before: The passive turning is a mysterious state of unbelief.
changed_reading.after: The turning is inspectable as a practiced loop in which recognized signs are twisted into dispute and redescribed as false until orientation is reversed.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because خالق here strongly denotes actual divine creation, yet its own branch inventory preserves fabricated speech and the focus pairs it with truth-displaced أفك, while 40:5 supplies unreal claims that try to dislodge truth; retain it only as a lexical counter-image and render it explicitly as an exploratory contrast, never as an equation of divine creation with lying.

activation_trace.role: Fabrication of speech supplies a branch-distant counterfeit to the Creator's measured and actual making.
A lie displaced from truth links counterfeit speech to the focus's final reversal.
Claiming what has no reality supplies the content of the opponents' verbal counter-world.
Trying to make the true proof fall gives counterfeit discourse its intended displacement effect.

changed_reading.before: Creation and turning away belong to separate parts of the sentence.
changed_reading.after: Genuine measured making is shadowed by counterfeit verbal making that fabricates a world in which creation no longer points to its Creator.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The ecological transfer is surprising, but it is anchored in the focus inventory's exact image of land deprived when rain is diverted and sharpened by descending sky-provision plus failed gratitude; downstream prose should present it as a material analogy for reception, not as the primary lexical sense of the passive verb.

activation_trace.role: Land from which rain has been turned supplies the barren-receiver image directly from the focus root.
Delivery downward makes provision an offered influx toward a receiving field.
Rain descending as provision makes the packet's sky-gift materially match the focus branch's absent rain.
Failed recognition of benefit supplies the human nonresponse analogous to land producing no grateful growth.

changed_reading.before: Turning away is only abstract misorientation.
changed_reading.after: The turned-away receiver can be pictured as land from which rain is diverted: provision descends, but denial leaves no answering growth.

strongest_changes: Universal creation became a configured habitat and measured life-course rather than undifferentiated production.
No deity except Him became an exclusive address-response, obedience, and jurisdiction relation rather than an abstract numerical claim.
The passive turning became a socially and discursively reproduced directional process through rival calls, denial, dispute, and recasting.
Every thing became one coextensive field of creation, mercy, knowledge, disclosure, and true judgment.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet placed exact repeated forms immediately around the focus and activated both the split ر ب ب to ر ب و growth reading and materially distant ء ف ك images without requiring remote orientation.
remaining_uncertainties: The passive agent in تؤفكون remains open among self-redirection, rival social calls, argumentative recasting, and consequential divine misguidance.
The ر ب و growth mapping is form-distant and should remain exploratory beside the dominant ر ب ب nurture branch.
The configured affordances may illustrate the Creator's work without lexically defining خالق, and the two outliers should remain qualified analogies.
